text.en:
Today you say what was going on at that moment.
I was reading.
She was driving.
We were waiting.
They were packing.
It shows a little scene.

title.en: Was or were, then a word with ing

text.en:
I, he, she or one thing: was.
You, we or they: were.
Then add ing: reading, waiting.
I was reading when the phone rang.
One thing goes on. Another thing happens.
I dropped my keys while I was running.

You will say what you were doing.
At six, I was walking home.
We were having breakfast at seven.
To ask, put was or were first.
To say no, add not after it.
